guidanceConsulted.query: responsive documentation page tables code blocks semantic html
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use standard semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), single <h1> with sequential headings, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-scrollable code blocks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, sequential h1/h2/h3, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> on all markup, WebIDL, and JS blocks.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible navigation table scrolling mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide captioned data tables with <th scope>, keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll regions with role='region' and accessible labels, visible :focus-visible outlines, and aria-live announcements for asynchronous UI results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: all data tables carry <caption> and <th scope='col|row'> inside tabindex='0' role='region' .table-wrap containers with 3px :focus-visible outlines, and the JS example demonstrates a role='status' aria-live='polite' announcement for installresult.
